issuer.title: Example University — digital diploma
issuer.heading: Example University
issuer.intro: Congratulations on your graduation. Your diploma is available as a digital credential ({configuration}) that you can keep in your wallet.
issuer.otherDevice: On a different device? These show a QR code to scan with your wallet instead:
issuer.qrLater: Show a QR code (issuance takes a while)
issuer.meta: This is the Credential Issuer's web page in OID4VCI Appendix H. The first two links build a Credential Offer and send you to your wallet at {wallet} (H.1, same device). The other two hand the offer over by QR code and a Transaction Code instead — H.2, and H.3 where the issuer needs time to produce the credential. The issuer is {issuer}.
offer.title: Example University — scan to receive your credential
offer.heading: Scan this with your wallet
offer.ready: Your digital diploma is ready to be claimed.
offer.readyDeferred: Your digital diploma is ready to be claimed, though issuing it will take us a little time once you ask.
offer.typeCode: Then type this Transaction Code into your wallet:
offer.codeOnlyHere: It is shown here, and only here — it does not travel in the QR code.
offer.meta: OID4VCI Appendix {appendix}. The offer uses the pre-authorized_code grant: you already identified yourself to this issuer, so your wallet goes straight to the token endpoint — there is no authorization request.
offer.metaDeferred: The credential endpoint will answer with a transaction_id and your wallet will have to come back for the credential.
offer.openHere: Open it in a wallet on this device
verifier.title: The Bar Door — are you over 21?
verifier.heading: The Bar Door
verifier.asking: We need to see that you are who you say you are — but only that. Present the {claims} claim(s) from a credential of type {type}, and nothing else.
verifier.askingAll: This door is currently asking for no particular claim, which in DCQL means the whole credential: the request carries no claims member, so your wallet is being asked for a credential of type {type} and everything in it.
verifier.ldpOmitted: {count, plural, one {# of these is} other {# of these are}} asked for in the other formats and not in this one: {claims} — an ldp_vc credential is signed over canonicalized JSON-LD, so a claim the vendored context defines no term for cannot be named at all, and it is dropped from the query rather than asked for under a name that would fail canonicalization.
verifier.formats: This request asks for a {format} credential. A presentation cannot convert between formats, so a wallet holding a different one has nothing to answer with — pick the format you hold:
verifier.formatsNote: jwt_vc_json has no selective disclosure, so presenting it hands over every claim it carries. ldp_vc discloses over canonical statements with a bbs-2023 derived proof, and each presentation is unlinkable to the last.
verifier.meta: This is the Verifier in OID4VP. It builds an Authorization Request with response_type=vp_token, a dcql_query naming the claims above, a fresh nonce, and response_mode=direct_post — so your wallet POSTs the presentation to {response} rather than putting it in a URL. The wallet is at {wallet}.
verifier.configure: What it asks for is configuration, not a constant: the admin console's Verifier request tab chooses the claims and the format, from the same catalogue of LDAP attribute types the issuer fills a credential from.
request.title: The Bar Door — scan to present
request.heading: Scan this with your wallet
request.sub: Your wallet will show you exactly which claims we are asking for before anything is sent.
request.waiting: This page moves on by itself once your wallet has answered; it asks every {poll} seconds.
request.meta: OID4VP cross-device flow. The wallet is on your other device, so it cannot be redirected — it reads the request from this code and POSTs the presentation straight back to us (response_mode=direct_post). The nonce in the request is what stops a presentation from being replayed.
qr.tooLong: This is too long for a QR code. Open it in your wallet with the link below.
done.titleAccepted: The Bar Door — come on in
done.heading: The Bar Door
done.askedFor: We asked for {requested} and that is all we know about you.
done.nothing: Nothing has been presented for this request yet.
